verdict.rationale: Signup automatically creates a Buyer Agent with its own pre-funded wallet. The agent spends from it via pay tokens whose amounts are committed against the wallet's available balance. A documented Get Agent's Wallet Balance API reports available, held, pending-charge and pending-deposit amounts. User control comes through per-agent scoped API keys, token amount ceilings and expiries, and account deactivation. missing for 10: documented self-serve top-up flow for individual users (the funding SDK is described for Enterprise customers), explicit owner-set spending limits or budgets and per-token revocation, independent or hands-on corroboration of wallet funding and spending.
